Expected gain in B bounded: RE in A acts on the 'seen through by A' class (0.55 pp); the 'not observed by A' 0.72 pp is read from A's 1 fps frames only (a subset of A's frames), the 5-15 cm class (0.39 pp) was shown inert by the B proxy.
